title: New Daily Diabetes Pill for Weight Loss Launches in UK Pharmacies
subtitle: A new oral treatment offers an alternative for patients who prefer pills over injections.

summary.en: A new daily pill called Foundayo has been launched in UK pharmacies to treat diabetes and support weight loss. This medication is the first of its kind to be available in Europe. It provides an alternative for patients who cannot or do not want to use injectable weight-loss treatments. However, experts are warning the public about the dangers of buying fake or unlicensed versions of these drugs online. The government is now being urged to make these treatments more accessible through the public health system.
summary.zh: 一款名為 Foundayo 的全新每日口服藥物已在英國藥局上市，用於治療糖尿病並協助減重。這是歐洲首款上市的同類藥物，為無法或不願使用注射減重療法的患者提供了替代方案。然而，專家警告大眾，在網路上購買偽藥或未經許可的藥物存在危險。目前各界正敦促政府透過公共醫療系統，讓更多患者能更便利地取得這些治療。

paragraphs.en: A new daily pill designed to treat type 2 diabetes and assist with weight loss has officially arrived in UK pharmacies. The drug, known as Foundayo and produced by the US pharmaceutical company Eli Lilly, received approval from the Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency (MHRA) earlier this month. This launch marks a significant moment, as the UK is the first country in Europe to make this specific oral treatment available to patients.
paragraphs.zh: 一款旨在治療第二型糖尿病並協助減重的全新每日口服藥物，已正式在英國藥局上架。這款名為 Foundayo 的藥物由美國製藥公司禮來（Eli Lilly）生產，並於本月初獲得英國藥品及保健產品管理局（MHRA）的核准。此次上市具有指標性意義，因為英國是歐洲第一個向患者提供此類特定口服療法的國家。

paragraphs.en: According to The Guardian Health, the medication is intended for individuals who meet specific health criteria. It is licensed for those with a body mass index (BMI) of 30 or higher, or for people with a BMI between 27 and 30 who also suffer from at least one weight-related health condition. Additionally, the pill can be used to help patients manage their blood sugar levels if they have type 2 diabetes that is not well-controlled. One of the main advantages of this treatment is that it is taken once a day, and patients do not need to follow any special rules regarding food or water intake.
paragraphs.zh: 根據《衛報健康版》（The Guardian Health）報導，該藥物適用於符合特定健康標準的族群。其核准對象為身體質量指數（BMI）達 30 以上者，或是 BMI 介於 27 至 30 之間且患有至少一種與體重相關健康問題的人士。此外，若患者的第二型糖尿病控制不佳，該藥物亦可用於協助管理血糖。此療法的主要優點之一是每日僅需服用一次，且患者無需遵循任何關於飲食或飲水的特殊規定。

paragraphs.en: Khalil Asmar, the vice-president of cardiometabolic health at Lilly Northern Europe, expressed satisfaction with the launch. He noted that this provides another oral treatment option for eligible patients alongside existing injectable medicines. Currently, the drug is available through private prescriptions. The company is also working with the National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (Nice) to see if the pill can eventually be provided through the National Health Service (NHS) in England.
paragraphs.zh: 禮來北歐地區心臟代謝健康部門副總裁卡利爾·阿斯馬（Khalil Asmar）對此次上市表示欣慰。他指出，這為符合條件的患者提供了除現有注射藥物之外的另一種口服治療選擇。目前，該藥物可透過私人處方取得。該公司也正與英國國家健康與照顧卓越研究院（Nice）合作，評估未來是否能透過英格蘭的國家醫療保健服務（NHS）提供此藥物。

paragraphs.en: For many patients, the arrival of a pill is a welcome change. Henry Gregg, the chief executive of the National Pharmacy Association, explained that this is a significant development for those who cannot use or simply do not want to use injectable medicines. By offering a pill, doctors may be able to provide weight-loss support to a much wider range of patients who were previously unable to access such treatments.
paragraphs.zh: 對許多患者而言，口服藥物的出現是一項令人樂見的改變。英國全國藥局協會（National Pharmacy Association）執行長亨利·格雷格（Henry Gregg）解釋，對於無法使用或單純不想使用注射藥物的患者來說，這是一項重大進展。透過提供口服藥物，醫師或許能為更多先前無法取得此類療法的患者提供減重支援。

paragraphs.en: Despite the excitement surrounding the new medication, there are serious concerns about safety. Experts are warning the public about the growing problem of fake, unlicensed, or counterfeit drugs. Counterfeit drugs are fake medicines that are made to look like real ones but may contain dangerous or ineffective ingredients. Because pills are often easier to produce than injectable pens, they are a common target for illegal sellers. The MHRA has already taken action against this illegal market, including seizing a large amount of unlicensed weight-loss products from a factory in Northampton last year. Furthermore, Eli Lilly is currently taking legal action against various suppliers accused of running an illegal hidden market for its products.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管大眾對這款新藥感到興奮，但仍存在嚴重的安全疑慮。專家正警告大眾，偽藥、未經許可或仿冒藥物的問題日益嚴重。仿冒藥物是指外觀模仿真藥但可能含有危險或無效成分的假藥。由於藥丸通常比注射筆更容易製造，因此成為非法賣家的常見目標。英國藥品及保健產品管理局已針對此非法市場採取行動，包括去年在北安普敦的一間工廠查扣了大量未經許可的減重產品。此外，禮來公司目前也正對多家被控經營非法地下市場販售其產品的供應商採取法律行動。

paragraphs.en: Because of these risks, health officials are urging patients to be extremely careful. They advise that people should only access weight-loss treatments through safe, regulated, and official pharmacies. Buying medication from unauthorized websites or social media sellers can put a patient’s health at serious risk, as there is no way to know if the product is safe or if it contains the correct medicine.
paragraphs.zh: 由於這些風險，衛生官員呼籲患者務必極度謹慎。他們建議民眾僅能透過安全、受監管且合法的藥局取得減重療法。從未經授權的網站或社群媒體賣家購買藥物，會使患者的健康面臨嚴重風險，因為民眾無從得知產品是否安全，或是否含有正確的藥物成分。

paragraphs.en: Looking ahead, there is a push to change how these treatments are distributed. Currently, many patients face what is known as a "postcode lottery" when trying to access weight management services through their local doctors. This means that a person's ability to get treatment depends heavily on where they live, rather than their medical needs. Henry Gregg of the National Pharmacy Association argued that there must be a stronger effort from the government and the NHS to use pharmacies to help more patients. He believes that by using pharmacies, the system could ensure that those who are in clinical need can get the help they require more easily.
paragraphs.zh: 展望未來，各界正推動改變這些療法的配發方式。目前，許多患者在嘗試透過當地醫師取得體重管理服務時，面臨所謂的「郵遞區號樂透」困境。這意味著一個人能否獲得治療，很大程度上取決於居住地，而非醫療需求。全國藥局協會的格雷格主張，政府與國家醫療保健服務必須更積極地利用藥局來協助更多患者。他認為，透過藥局系統，能確保有臨床需求的患者更輕易地獲得所需的協助。

paragraphs.en: This launch follows the approval of another GLP-1 pill for weight loss in June. GLP-1 is a type of medicine that mimics a hormone in the body to help control appetite and blood sugar. As more of these options become available, the focus for health authorities will remain on balancing the need for wider access with the critical need to protect patients from the dangers of the illegal drug market.
paragraphs.zh: 此次上市是在六月另一款用於減重的類升糖素胜肽-1（GLP-1）口服藥物獲准後所進行的。類升糖素胜肽-1 是一種能模擬體內荷爾蒙以協助控制食慾與血糖的藥物。隨著此類選擇日益增加，衛生當局的重點將持續放在平衡擴大取得管道的需求，以及保護患者免受非法藥物市場危害的關鍵任務之間。

keyTerms.definitionEn: To indicate or represent a significant stage or event in a process.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 標誌著、象徵（某個重要時刻或階段）。
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作名詞（分數、標記），這裡作動詞，表示一個事件的里程碑。文中：This launch marks a significant moment, as the UK is the first country in Europe to make this specific oral treatment available to patients.

keyTerms.definitionEn: A situation where the quality or availability of services depends on the area where a person lives.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 郵遞區號樂透（指服務品質或取得機會取決於居住地區，而非個人需求）。
keyTerms.noteZh: 這是一個英國常見的慣用語，字面上像樂透，實際指資源分配不均。文中：Currently, many patients face what is known as a "postcode lottery" when trying to access weight management services through their local doctors.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To function or act in the same way as something else, often to produce a similar effect.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見於描述動作模仿，這裡指藥物在體內模擬荷爾蒙的作用。文中：GLP-1 is a type of medicine that mimics a hormone in the body to help control appetite and blood sugar.

sources.name: The Guardian Health
sources.title: New daily diabetes pill that helps with weight loss launches in UK pharmacies

quiz.question: According to the article, which of the following individuals would be eligible to receive the new pill, Foundayo?

options.A: A person with a BMI of 28 who has no other health conditions.
options.B: A person with a BMI of 31 who does not have type 2 diabetes.
options.C: A person with a BMI of 25 who is struggling with weight management.
options.D: A person who is currently using injectable medicine and wants to switch to a pill for better effectiveness.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第二段，該藥物適用於 BMI 30 以上的人，或 BMI 在 27 到 30 之間且患有至少一種體重相關疾病的人。選項 A 的 BMI 為 28 但無其他疾病，不符合標準；選項 C 的 BMI 25 低於門檻；選項 D 文章中並未提及藥物效果比注射劑更好，僅提到它是另一種選擇。

quiz.question: What can be inferred about the current accessibility of weight-loss treatments in the UK?

options.A: Most patients can easily obtain weight-loss medication through the NHS regardless of their location.
options.B: The government has successfully eliminated the illegal market for weight-loss pills.
options.C: Patients' ability to receive medical support for weight loss is inconsistent across different regions.
options.D: The new pill is currently the only weight-loss treatment available to patients in the UK.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據文章第七段提到的「postcode lottery」（郵遞區號樂透），這意味著患者能否獲得治療取決於居住地，而非醫療需求，這暗示了治療取得的不一致性。選項 A 與文章描述的「郵遞區號樂透」矛盾；選項 B 文章提到非法市場仍是嚴重問題；選項 D 文章最後一段提到已有其他 GLP-1 藥物獲批，故不正確。

quiz.question: In the final paragraph, what does the word 'mimics' mean as used in the context of GLP-1 medicine?

options.A: To copy the appearance or function of something.
options.B: To create a fake version of a product for profit.
options.C: To increase the intensity of a natural process.
options.D: To replace a missing part of the body permanently.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。文中提到 GLP-1 藥物「mimics a hormone」（模擬荷爾蒙）以控制食慾，這裡的 mimic 指的是藥物在體內發揮類似於天然荷爾蒙的功能。選項 B 是指非法仿冒藥（counterfeit），與此處語境無關；選項 C 雖然藥物有效果，但 mimic 強調的是「模仿」機制而非單純「增強」；選項 D 藥物並非取代身體部位。

quiz.question: What is the primary message of the article regarding the launch of the new weight-loss pill?

options.A: The new pill will completely replace all existing injectable weight-loss treatments in the UK.
options.B: The UK government has officially banned all online sales of weight-loss medication to protect citizens.
options.C: While the new pill offers a convenient treatment option, its launch highlights both the need for better access and the risks of illegal markets.
options.D: The pharmaceutical company Eli Lilly is the only organization authorized to provide health advice in the UK.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。本文全面探討了新藥上市帶來的正面影響（便利性、更多選擇），同時也強調了隨之而來的挑戰，包括非法藥物市場的風險以及現行醫療體系分配不均的問題。選項 A 過於誇大；選項 B 文章僅提到建議去正規藥局，並未說全面禁止線上銷售；選項 D 為錯誤資訊，Eli Lilly 僅是藥廠，並非醫療建議機構。
